scientific_integrity: The count is an exhaustive finite classification of all \(2^{16}\) linear maps. A second coordinate implementation rechecks accepted maps on every element pair, and the automorphism group is independently brute-force enumerated. Literature searches do not prove absolute novelty; an inaccessible older paper is explicitly recorded as a residual risk although its indexed abstract excludes characteristic two.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the field \(\mathbb F_2\), weight zero, and the four-dimensional exterior algebra. It does not classify larger characteristic-two fields, nonzero weights, or higher exterior rank.
title: Weight-zero Rota–Baxter operators on the four-dimensional exterior algebra over \(\mathbb F_2\)
